name: Equinix Lisbon LS1
notes: Equinix lists LS1 as an operating Lisbon IBX data center in its Portugal/Lisbon portfolio; capacity disclosed as colocation space rather than IT MW.

name: Equinix Lisbon LS2
notes: Equinix announced LS2 with about EUR50m initial investment and 2,050 sqm of colocation space; Equinix now lists LS2 in its Lisbon data center portfolio.

name: MERLIN Properties / Edged Lisbon AI Campus
notes: Five-building AI data center campus in Vila Franca de Xira, near Lisbon, announced at start of construction with 180 MW of critical power.

name: AtlasEdge Lisbon campus LIS001/LIS002
notes: AtlasEdge announced green financing for LIS001 and LIS002 at its Lisbon/Carnaxide campus, with combined capacity of 21.1 MW and future campus capacity expected to reach 30 MW.

name: CIMAA Alto Alentejo shared services data center
notes: Intermunicipal IT data center physically located in Portalegre with a redundant second site in Elvas, built for Alto Alentejo shared digital services.

name: IP Telecom Porto Data Center
notes: IP Telecom states it owns three Portuguese data centers in Lisbon, Porto, and Viseu; datacenters.com lists the Porto facility for colocation, virtual data center, storage, backup, disaster recovery, cybersecurity, and connectivity.

name: NFSI Telecom Porto1 Datacentre
notes: Third-party facility directories list PORTO1 at Rua Dr. Alfredo Magalhaes, Porto, offering suites, cages, footprints, racks, and partial racks.

name: NOS Data Center NS Matosinhos
notes: Facility directory lists NOS Data Center NS in Matosinhos, Porto district, as an operating NOS Sistemas data center.

name: APDL Data Center Campus
developer: Administracao dos Portos do Douro, Leixoes e Viana do Castelo (APDL)
notes: Uptime Institute lists APDL Data Center Campus in Santa Cruz do Bispo, Portugal, under APDL awards; public capacity not found.

name: RNCA Guimaraes / FCT Data Center
developer: Fundacao para a Ciencia e a Tecnologia; University of Minho; DST
notes: New EUR5.1m National Advanced Computing Center facility on the University of Minho Azurem campus in Guimaraes; included under Porto-region coverage because major public directories group Guimaraes with the Porto market.

name: EDC One Pego Data Center
notes: Planned data center in Pego, Abrantes, in Santarem district; reported EUR7bn investment, three phases, target operation in Q2 2028, and municipal tax exemptions/interest designation.

name: Hyperion II Renewables Services Pego Data Center
notes: Abrantes approved a prior information request for a second Pego-area data center project; company described it as in environmental/municipal licensing with 200 MVA grid connection and expected operation in 2029. Capacity_mw left null because source gives MVA, not IT MW.

name: Start Campus SINES Data Campus
notes: Hyperscale AI-ready campus in Sines, Setubal district, with 1.2 GW secured/target IT capacity; first facility is operational and further buildings are under construction/planning.

name: Start Campus SIN01
notes: SIN01 is the first operational facility at the Sines campus; Start Campus site says SIN01 is operational, and ECO reports the first building has 31 MW.

name: Start Campus SIN02
notes: Second Sines building expected to start construction in February 2026 and complete in 2027; source reports about 65,000 sqm and 180 MW of IT load.

name: Voltekko Alcochete Data Center
notes: Eco-responsible AI/HPC colocation data center planned in Alcochete, Setubal district; directory specs list 15 MW fully built-out power, 6 MW under construction power, 2,400 sqm whitespace, estimated 2026.

name: Online.pt Barreiro Data Center
notes: Facility directory lists an operational Online.pt by 100 Limite data center at Rua 44-A, Barreiro, Setubal district.

name: CTS Group Viana do Castelo data center production campus
notes: Data-center supply-chain project rather than an IT-load hosting facility: CTS is building a roughly 21,000 sqm production hub in Viana do Castelo for EPODs, electrical panels, and modular components for data centers.

name: MTGREEN Zero-Carbon Datacenter, Sabroso de Aguiar
notes: Division name appears to be an English rendering of Vila Real. Project is in Vila Pouca de Aguiar, Vila Real district; local reports describe a EUR7.2m zero-carbon datacenter in Sabroso de Aguiar promoted by MTGREEN.

name: IP Telecom Viseu Data Center
notes: IP Telecom states it owns data centers in Lisbon, Porto, and Viseu; third-party directories list the Viseu facility at Av. Cap. Homem Ribeiro and describe colocation/cloud/connectivity services.

name: Google Azores CLS / Nuvem-Sol data center
notes: Google cable landing/data infrastructure site in Lagoa, Sao Miguel, Azores, associated with Nuvem and Sol subsea cables; third-party specs report 10 MW and 15,000 sqm, with service around 2026-2027.

name: Azores Cloud dual data centers
notes: Regional government announcement describes Azores Cloud as integrating two new data centers for regional cloud services; exact publication day not visible in search result, date approximated to month from source age.

name: NOS Ponta Delgada Data Center
notes: NOS inaugurated a Ponta Delgada, Sao Miguel data center to support cloud and associated services in the Azores; reports cite 260 sqm of accumulated technical/hosting rooms in the region.

name: NOS Madeira Data Center, Funchal
notes: NOS reopened/renovated its Funchal data center after a EUR500,000 modernization, reporting improved energy efficiency and support for 5G/cloud services.

name: EMACOM / EEM New Madeira Tier III Datacenter
developer: EMACOM; Empresa de Electricidade da Madeira; Regional Government of Madeira
notes: Madeira government search results list a Tier III datacenter under construction in Virtudes, Funchal, promoted by EMACOM/EEM, and a separate government investment item citing EUR15.5m for the new Madeira datacenter.

name: CTM/MEO Madeira Data Centre
notes: IBC Madeira describes CTM/MEO Data Centre adjacent to the submarine cable station with redundancy and direct international network integration; MEO says its national data center network includes Madeira.
